يضطهدوا (form VIII)
# يَضْطَهِدُوا (yaḍṭahidū) /jadˤ.tˤa.hi.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# يُضْطَهَدُوا (yuḍṭahadū) /judˤ.tˤa.ha.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
